findings.title: R2-03: bounded rank cannot satisfy the original three-observation descent guard
findings.claim: The proposed replacement score R(T,P) in 0..B, strictly decreasing under two steps whenever three canonical center observations agree, cannot exist universally.
findings.scope: Every uniformly bounded natural score on canonical pairs, including ranks of all fixed-dimensional matrices over any field. Not the unbounded integer off-diagonal score from round one.
findings.result: A written pigeonhole proof forces B+1 strict drops; exact single-seed witnesses cover B=1,2,3. At B=2, T=1,P=25 gives the repeated block 1011100.
limitations: The general proof has not been formalized or kernel-replayed.
Does not exclude unbounded scores, growing dimensions, or descent guarded by infinite agreement.
findings.next_action: Stop fitting bounded rank to this guard; formalize the short obstruction if useful.

findings.title: R2-03: nonlinear source parities at separated binary scales
findings.claim: The dyadic difference matrix M(T,n,K)[i,j]=c(T+i+2^(K+j))+c(T+i), with 2^K>T+n-1 over GF(2), has an exact nonlinear source representation. Unbounded rank for T=0 would imply official Problem 1.
findings.scope: Actual Rule 30 single-seed center, with explicit finite-support and binary-kernel conditions. Proposed sufficient growth lemma U is open.
findings.result: Known Duhamel decomposition specialized to separated binary scales; 760 exact block checks and 32,780 crosschecked bits. Tested square-family ranks through size 12 are 0,1,1,3,5,6,6,7,8,10,10,11. Eventual period P after T0 bounds every such rank by T0+P.
limitations: No unbounded rank growth or all-r odd-minor construction is proved.
Duhamel and rank reformulations are prior work, not claimed new.
No Lean replay, Wolfram approval, full solution or proximity estimate.
Ether and driven finite-half controls do not inherit the finite single-seed support identity.
findings.next_action: Try an ancestry-based pairing of source/kernel determinant terms with an odd residual for arbitrarily large minors; allow cancellation and delayed rank gains.

findings.title: R2-03: time-monotone rank and a near-full-rank shortcut fail
findings.claim: Two proposed strengthenings fail: nondecreasing rank as T advances, and rank M(0,n,ceil(log2 n)) >= n-1 for every n>=2.
findings.scope: Actual single-seed center with the admissible separation condition. These failures concern only the two strengthenings, not the open growth lemma.
findings.result: At n=2,K=8, T=0 to T=1 drops rank 1 to 0. At n=3,K=2, rows 000,001,000 have rank 1, below n-1=2.
limitations: Dependency on F002 is its matrix definition only, not its unproved growth claim.
No bound on eventual rank follows. Matrices at changing K are not nested.
findings.next_action: Use these counterexamples as mandatory controls for any proposed minor-growth proof.
